facts.fact: Caren 用一句反讽挡回 Miguel 的追问，她开口时声音压得很低、在发抖。
Caren 说 Yumi 看见 Van 闯进别人家，这是她去找 Jo 对质的原因之一。
facts.anchor: Yumi told me she saw Van breaking into houses—”

facts.fact: Miguel 双手合十，用祈祷的口气回应 Caren「Jo 在我酒里下药」的指控。
facts.anchor: “Please, dear Lord, please tell me you did not accuse Jo Allard of drugging you.”

facts.fact: Rachel 承认那只金手镯是 Van 送的。
facts.anchor: “Van gave it to me,” she says softly.

facts.fact: Rachel 说自己早就隐约知道 Van 进别人家拿东西。
facts.anchor: he had been going into people’s houses and stuff

facts.fact: Rachel 说返校节那晚在 Van 房间，她想走而 Van 不放她走。
Caren 从 Rachel 的眼神看出，她当晚打电话求助的是父亲。
Rachel 说父亲才是与 Van 父母安排退还赃物的人。
facts.anchor: Dad was the one who actually arranged it all with Van’s parents.

facts.fact: Miguel 把隐瞒解释成保护这个家，并说 Caren 让这件事变得很难。
facts.anchor: I’m trying to protect this family. But you’re making it kind of hard.
